get_autotuner_cache: get the autotuner cache dictionary used by split-k FMHA kernels for storing autotuning results
set_autotuner_cache: set the autotuner cache dictionary used by split-k FMHA kernels to store autotuning results
AUTOTUNER_KEY: access the autotuner key string used to look up cached autotuning parameters in split-k FMHA kernels
